storageProposal.canonicalValue: Preserve journey_members.display_name as the sole Trip nickname. No parallel self_nickname override or account profile fallback.
storageProposal.clear: Wire null is explicit cleared nickname; canonical display_name becomes empty string (existing NOT NULL preserved). Read maps empty display_name to nickname:null; legacy displayName projection remains string, potentially empty. No previous-name restoration/global-name replacement.
storageProposal.newRevision: journey_members.nickname_revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, safe integer bound; increments exactly once only on actual name change. Initial existing rows revision0. Independent of participation/account/access revisions.
storageProposal.receipt: Dedicated immutable typed nickname command receipts, following existing Person receipt pattern; not reuse participation/create receipt schemas or create a generic save subsystem. New table/column/functions/ACL are DESIGN ONLY, exact protected install package remains required.
storageProposal.otherWriters: All existing/future display_name UPDATE paths must increment nickname revision atomically or be rejected by owning transition guard. INSERT retains initial revision0; linking/role/participation changes alone never bump nickname revision. Exact writer/guard interaction must be reviewed before implementation/install.
storageProposal.legacyObservations: SET validation is trimmed nonblank Unicode <=256 scalars, but existing/prior read values have no length/trim bound. Never truncate or reject legacy long/whitespace nickname merely to read, recover history or clear. Empty canonical storage maps null wire; no implicit clear from an empty SET.

atomicSemantics: Authenticate and qualify same current linked self Person within Trip, reject missing/ambiguous/revoked/foreign binding. Never use role=Owner to edit another person.
Lock operation identity and Person row under existing PostgreSQL transaction patterns; revalidate linked identity/access under lock.

Look up exact original receipt before attempting new mutation; return original result for identical request without CAS reapply. A stored receipt is historical result, not proof of current roster value.

Mismatch expected revision => immutable REVISION_CONFLICT receipt, no name change; desired equal current with correct revision => UNCHANGED and no increment; otherwise APPLIED revision+1 and nickname update+receipt atomically.
No partial row or receipt on failure. No counter rollover; exhausted revisions reject. No automatic rebase/new operation on conflict.
Only authoritative fresh read can establish current nickname value/revision. Local draft and accepted server snapshot remain distinct.

receipt.validation: APPLIED => result revision prior+1, value changed and equals desired. UNCHANGED => revision/value unchanged and desired equals prior. CONFLICT => expected!=prior revision, resulting=prior. Identical replay returns same receipt; only response envelope idempotentReplay changes.
